'''Lackey WYS RFCs''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Lackey]]
* '''Published:''' 19 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]

* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed WYS Lackey LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Well, it basically goes as follows. Its WYS, so it nearly plays itself as long as you know the rules to the game. Nothing braniac tech going on in my deck, so it's just a fairly efficient pound deck.
